compiled_state.description:
## Context

ADR 0075 retired the single-pass review engine in favour of the plan-review gate.
Predecessor slices have since removed every caller — the ticket-quality eval
solver branch, the `review_workflows` harness, and the five tests that used the
engine merely as a vehicle for gate-source and schema contracts. This slice deletes the engine itself.

What remains in `src/rebar/llm/operations.py` is live and stays:
`assemble_context` has a production consumer at
`src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py:192` (the completion gate's base context),
`_format_ticket` is its helper (`operations.py:108`, `:124`), and
`select_reviewers` is re-exported through `src/rebar/llm/__init__.py:59`. This is
surgery on a surviving module, not a file deletion.

Three coupled symbols die together:

- `_review_ticket_impl` — the engine.
- `default_reviewer_id` — after the predecessor slices its only references are
  `operations.py:33` (`__all__`) and `:167` (inside the engine). Its docstring
  claims "the review-workflow op and the completion gate" call it; the former is
  already gone and no completion-gate caller exists, so this makes it dead.
- `_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS` — the step floor, used only at `:165`-`:166`.

**Line numbers.** Predecessors shift lines in several files below, so citations
appear ONLY for the four they do not touch (`operations.py`,
`test_review_budget.py`, `test_subcall_class_selection.py`,
`test_review_output_budget.py`), measured at
`e2ed08b343a2be462de4433a93edbb5cbc062a52`. Everything else is named by `def`;
locate deletions by name regardless.

## Approach

Delete the three symbols and the tests whose only subject is their behaviour,
prune the newly-unused imports, correct `__all__` and the module docstring, and
record the removal in the release notes. Deletion only — nothing is added, moved,
or reimplemented.

## Scope

In scope: `src/rebar/llm/operations.py`, `docs/release-notes.md`, and the six
test modules named under Testing. Out of scope, verified rather than assumed:

- `assemble_context`, `_format_ticket`, `select_reviewers` — live, per the
  consumers cited above. AC4 asserts `assemble_context` survives.
- `tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py:214,240` — their
  `monkeypatch.setattr` targets are the **string**
  `"rebar.llm.operations.assemble_context"`, which survives. Untouched.
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_prefetch.py`,
  `test_completion_child_scope.py`, `test_child_closure_evidence_6ec8.py` —
  import `operations` only for `assemble_context`. Untouched.
- `src/rebar/llm/prompting/` and the reviewer catalog — the `ticket-quality`
  prompt and the default-reviewer flip are next slice's work.

## Testing

No new tests. Six modules lose engine-only tests; locate each by `def` name.

**`src/rebar/llm/operations.py`** — delete `_review_ticket_impl` (`def :135`),
`default_reviewer_id` (`def :45`), and `_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS` (`:42`) together with
its explanatory comment (`:35-41`). Drop `"default_reviewer_id"` from `__all__`
(`:33`), leaving `["assemble_context", "select_reviewers"]`. Rewrite the module
docstring (`:1-17`), whose `:6-8` states "The engine survives as
:func:`_review_ticket_impl` for the two internal callers (the workflow-parity
harness and the eval solver)" — both callers and the engine are now gone.

These imports become unused and ruff will flag them: `replace` (`:21`),
`LLMConfig`/`resolve_gate_config` (`:24`), `LLMError` (`:25`), `prompts` (`:26`),
`Runner`/`RunRequest`/`get_runner` (`:28`). **Keep** the `select_reviewers`
re-export (`:27`) and the `TYPE_CHECKING`/`PrefetchSpec` block (`:22`, `:30-31`),
which `assemble_context` needs.

**`tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_budget.py`** — delete the whole file
(80 lines). Both tests (`def :47`, `:67`) and `_RecordingRunner` (`:19`) exist
only to assert the `_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS` floor, which its docstring (`:1`) names.

**`tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py`** — four coupled sites. Delete
`test_review_ticket_uses_the_operators_configured_model` (`def :102`, engine call
`:117`); delete the `"llm/operations.py::_review_ticket_impl"` key from the
`_UNFOLLOWABLE` dict (`:212`, entry at `:247`); delete that key's row from
`_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES` (`:486`); and change `assert
len(_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES) == 21` (`:532`) to `== 20`. The `_UNFOLLOWABLE`
deletion is not optional: `test_neither_registry_has_stale_entries` (`def :600`)
asserts `set(_UNFOLLOWABLE) <= by_verdict["unresolved"]`, so a left-behind entry
fails that guard.

**`tests/unit/workflow/test_review_output_budget.py`** — delete only
`test_review_ticket_request_carries_model_max` (`def :414`, engine call `:428`).
Keep `test_all_review_gate_yamls_opt_into_model_max` (`def :435`) and every other
test; the surviving `max_output_cfg` call sites keep their own coverage.

**`tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py`** — delete the four engine tests
`test_review_ticket_end_to_end`, `test_review_ticket_executes_repository_prompt_override`,
`test_review_ticket_graph_includes_children`, and
`test_review_ticket_unknown_reviewer_is_llmerror`. Do **not** touch
`test_cli_review_check`, which drives `review-plan --check` and never reaches the
engine, nor the reviewer-catalog tests near the top of the file — next slice.

**`tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_ops_characterization.py`** — delete
`test_review_ticket_contract` and `test_review_ticket_graph_target_kind`. Keep
`test_review_code_contract`, `test_scan_epics_for_spec_contract`, and
`test_review_result_validates_against_schema` (already repointed off the engine
by a predecessor slice).

**`tests/interfaces/store/test_review_as_workflow.py`** — delete
`test_public_review_ticket_entry_point_unchanged`, the file's last engine caller.
The module then holds one test,
`test_runner_agent_step_bridge_runs_an_agent_workflow`; rewrite the module
docstring to match. Do **not** rename the file — that surviving test still
concerns running a review-shaped workflow through the executor.

**Release notes.** Add an unreleased-section entry recording removal of
`_review_ticket_impl`, `default_reviewer_id`, and `_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS`. The
existing entry at `docs/release-notes.md:946` ("**The engine STAYS.**") is
historical: leave it intact, superseded by the new one.

## Acceptance criteria

Each criterion is one command whose stated result is the pass condition.

- [ ] **AC1 — the engine and its two coupled symbols are gone.** Tree-wide, so
      it presumes the three blocking predecessors have landed: they own the last
      callers, in `eval_solver.py` and `review_workflows.py`.
      `git grep -n '_review_ticket_impl\|default_reviewer_id\|_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS' -- src tests docs scripts ':!tests/fixtures/' ':!docs/release-notes.md'`
      prints nothing and exits 1. Neither exclusion can be cleared:
      `tests/fixtures/` holds these names inside recorded transcript text, and
      the release notes must name them in the historical and the new entry.
- [ ] **AC2 — the budget test module is gone.**
      `test -e tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_budget.py` exits non-zero.
- [ ] **AC3 — the subcall census agrees with itself.**
      `pytest tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` exits 0, which runs the
      stale-entry guard `test_neither_registry_has_stale_entries` against both
      registries and the count assertion lowered to `20`.
- [ ] **AC4 — the surviving surface is intact.**
      `python -c "from rebar.llm import operations, select_reviewers as _s; assert operations.assemble_context; assert operations.__all__ == ['assemble_context', 'select_reviewers']"`
      exits 0.
- [ ] **AC5 — no unused imports were left behind.**
      `ruff check src/rebar/llm/operations.py` exits 0.
- [ ] **AC6 — the removal is recorded.**
      `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- docs/release-notes.md` shows
      additions and `0` deletions, and the added text names `_review_ticket_impl`.
- [ ] **AC7 — the suite is green.** `make verify` exits 0.
